headline: Kiwibank hikes mortgage rates, highest longer-term fixed
caption: Heads up, East Auckland! 📊 Kiwibank has adjusted their home loan rates, and they now have the highest carded rates for longer fixed terms. If you're looking to lock in a rate or refinance, this is a good reminder to shop around with your bank and get current quotes — your mortgage broker or lender should be able to walk you through what's changed and what works best for your situation.
original_title: Another major bank hikes home loan rates
